name: Unitree Robotics
summary:
Unitree Robotics develops legged robots, humanoids and robotic manipulators for research, consumer and industrial applications. Its portfolio spans quadruped platforms and bipedal robots, supported by internally developed motors, reducers, controllers and sensing technology.

The company combines mechanical design with motion control and environmental perception to produce robots capable of dynamic movement. Its platforms are used for developing locomotion, interaction and embodied-AI applications, with different configurations serving different budgets and operating needs. By working on both complete robots and core components, Unitree supports an ecosystem of developers building software and practical tasks on top of its hardware.
